result_text:
I fixed the typos in the four default scoping conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The existing `Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't add new tests, so the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML, `app.js` and `build-gradle.js` cases haven't been run.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern `(html|html|xhtml)` is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match too. `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **.NET assembly docs and `// Generated by …` JavaScript:** the path patterns `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so they match any `*.xml` or `*.js` file. Hand-written files stay out because the content check still has to match.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `*.gradle` is unchanged.

The `<doc>` content check is matched against a whole line (`matches()`), so the `<doc>` tag has to be alone on its line, as before. I left that as it was.
